column1: # Labelled questions for tuning and testing the suggester.
# Each line: the question, a tab, and the acceptable houses (comma-separated),
# the best first. Derived-house questions are labelled with the derived house.
Will I live a long life?
What does the coming year hold for me?
Will my health improve this year?
Am I on the right path in life?
How will people see my character?
Is my energy going to return?
Will my appearance change for the better?
Am I strong enough to face this?
Will I have enough money this month?
Can I afford a new laptop?
Where did I put my wallet?
Will I find my missing necklace?
Will I make a profit selling my bike?
Is my paycheck going to cover the bills?
Is this purchase a good idea?
# House 3: siblings, neighbours, news, short trips
Will I hear news from home?
Will my neighbours stop the noise?
Will I get a reply to my email?
Is the message I received true?
Is the rumour about me true?
Will the short trip go well?
Is the gossip at school about me?
Is this a good time to sell my house?
Will the landlord renew the lease?
Should I relocate to the countryside?
Will my family be at peace?
Will we find a new flat?
Should I take out a mortgage?
# House 5: children, pregnancy, romance, pleasure, gambling
Should I go on a date with him?
Is my crush interested in me?
Will my team win the game?
Should I take up painting as a hobby?
Will I recover from this illness?
Should I hire a new employee?
# House 7: marriage, partners, contracts, lawsuits, open enemies, thieves
Is my relationship going to last?
Will my business partner be honest?
Will the court rule in my favour?
Will my fiancée and I be happy?
Should we plan the nuptials for spring?
Will my girlfriend move in with me?
# House 8: death, fear, inheritance, others' money, debts
Will my debts be paid off?
Will I get my loan approved?
Should I be afraid of this?
Will the estate be settled fairly?
Is someone close to me going to die?
Will they pay back what they owe me?
# House 9: long journeys, religion, learning, law, dreams
Should I travel abroad this summer?
Will I find my faith again?
Is this spiritual path right for me?
Will my professor approve my research?
# House 10: career, honour, reputation, authority, mother
Will my boss like my work?
Is this the right profession for me?
Will I be offered the position?
Will my manager approve the project?
Should I start my own company?
Will I achieve success in my field?
Is my friendship with her real?
# House 12: secret enemies, confinement, sorrow, self-undoing
Is someone working against me in secret?
Will I be released from hospital?
Is someone hiding something from me?
Is there a curse on me?
Will my husband get the job?
Will my brother find a job?
Will my mother recover from her illness?
Will my partner inherit the house?
Will my son pass his exams?
Will my father sell the house?
Will my wife's surgery go well?
Will my boyfriend's career take off?
